summary: Sunshine Biopharma filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing a placement agent agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. for a best-efforts public offering of 10,509,082 common units at $0.55 each and 400,000 pre-funded units at $0.54999, each unit bundling one share (or pre-funded warrant) with two Series D warrants. The Series D warrants carry a $0.66 exercise price (120% of the unit price) and five-year term, with a ratchet floor of $0.275. Gross proceeds approximate $6.0 million. The pre-funded warrants were exercised in full pre-closing, leaving warrant overhang as the key dilution watch item.
